# Claim Adjudication: CLM-4471

## 🔄 Processing Pipeline

### 📥 STAGE 1: INTAKE
Claim ID CLM-4471; Claimed Amount $11,000; Peril Type Water Damage – Burst Pipe; Affected Areas Kitchen + Basement; Claimant Status Absent from property (~30 days).

### 📋 STAGE 2: POLICY CHECKER
Water damage (burst pipe) is a standard HO-3 covered peril. The ~30-day absence triggers a vacancy/unoccupancy clause review — most standard policies define vacancy at 30–60 days and may reduce or void water damage claims. Policy Status: ⚠️ CONDITIONAL — Requires Vacancy Clause Clarification.

### 🔍 STAGE 3: FRAUD SCORER
No hard red flags, but extended vacancy and unmitigated damage warrant standard verification steps.

### 💰 STAGE 4: PAYOUT CALCULATION
Full payout is HELD pending vacancy clause resolution and inspection results.

## 📊 SUPERVISOR SUMMARY & DECISION
Verdict: 🟡 CONDITIONAL APPROVAL — HOLD FOR INVESTIGATION. The vacancy/unoccupancy clause is the single most important coverage question and must be resolved before any payment is issued. Authorized Preliminary Payout: $0 (Full Hold). Potential Approved Range Upon Clearance: $7,500 – $10,000. Escalation Required: ✅ Yes — Vacancy clause determination requires senior adjuster sign-off.
